errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly states to 'Avoid ... making comparisons between lines.' This phrase directly compares the 'Final Accuracy' to the 'Initial Accuracy', violating the negative constraint.

The prompt requires the description to 'include representative values at the start and end of the x-axis' for each line. The generated description fails to provide the starting and ending values for either the 'Initial Accuracy' line (starts at approx. 0.35, ends at approx. 0.41) or the 'Final Accuracy' line (starts at approx. 0.65, ends at approx. 0.9).
